playlists.title: Science & What If
playlists.description: Surprising stories from evolution and prehistoric life, alongside imaginative what-if questions about physics. Explore natural history and thought experiments through paper-diorama worlds.

playlists.title: Reported IQ Estimates
playlists.description: A focused collection of published IQ estimates attributed to notable people. These figures are reported claims, not results from a single standardized or directly comparable test.

playlists.title: Digital Life & Attention
playlists.description: Short films about social media, attention, screen time, AI companions, digital relationships, and making room for life beyond the feed.

playlists.title: Legends & Personal Stories
playlists.description: Legends and adapted personal stories retold as paper-diorama films. These narratives may come from folklore, remembered accounts, or stories without independent verification.

playlists.title: Real Stories & Discoveries
playlists.description: Real events and lives reconstructed as paper-diorama films, with the story kept within what the available evidence supports.
